# Bhumi Vikas Sahayak

> Rule-cited answers from the Madhya Pradesh Bhumi Vikas Rules, 2012 for the Bhopal Municipal Corporation building-permission clerk. Every answer gives the rule number, verbatim rule text and PDF page; table numbers (setbacks, fees, FAR, clearances) come from unit-tested code; questions outside the rules return "not found"; later amendments (28-08-2026, Rule 2(5)(c)) are flagged. English and Hindi. Works offline without an API key.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to run, verify (`python verify.py`), CLI/API usage, answer schema, repo map, invariants
- [README.md](README.md): overview for humans, setup in 5 steps, accuracy, limitations

## Key code
- [backend/app/main.py](backend/app/main.py): pipeline `ask_events()` and HTTP API
- [backend/app/calculators/core.py](backend/app/calculators/core.py): rule tables + calculators
- [backend/app/verify.py](backend/app/verify.py): citation/number/amendment checks
- [backend/app/llm/engine.py](backend/app/llm/engine.py): Claude tool loop
- [eval/gold.jsonl](eval/gold.jsonl): evaluation questions with expected rules and numbers
